faq.a1: Fill in the request form with your school details. The platform reviews the request and, once approved, your school admin receives login details and a first-login checklist.
faq.a2: Yes. A paper can be built in Urdu, in English, or in both languages, and the preview switches between them before printing.
faq.a3: No. The answer key is a separate document. It is never printed on the same pages as the paper.
faq.a4: Your school admin reviews each submitted paper and approves it or sends it back with a comment. Schools can also switch approval off if they prefer.
faq.a5: Each plan sets how many teachers can use the platform and how many papers the school can build each month. Plans and prices are confirmed when your school is onboarded.
faq.a6: Yes. Request access and ask for a demo. The platform team will walk your school through a full paper, from setup to print.

announce.a: Open Announcements, write a short title and message, choose who it is for, and send it now or schedule it. Sent announcements appear in every targeted user's Notifications.
announce.q: How do I send an announcement?

approvePaper.a: Open Approvals, read the paper preview, then Approve it or Request changes with a comment. The teacher sees your comment on the paper.
approvePaper.q: How do I approve a paper?

approveSchool.a: Open the Approval queue, read the school's details and documents, then Approve it, ask for missing information, or Reject it with a reason.
approveSchool.q: How do I approve a school?

buildPaper.a: Open the Paper Studio, pick the class, subject and chapters, set the marks pattern, and let it fill the questions. Save a draft any time — it is saved automatically.
buildPaper.q: How do I build a paper?

inviteTeacher.a: Open Teachers, then Invite teacher, and enter the teacher's name and email. They join with the invitation link and appear as invited until they sign in.
inviteTeacher.q: How do I invite a teacher?

printPaper.a: Open an approved paper and choose Print. The paper and its answer key print as separate documents, in the language you chose in Settings.
printPaper.q: How do I print a paper?

submitPaper.a: In the Studio, finish the paper and choose Submit for approval. It moves to Submitted, and your school admin is notified to review it.
submitPaper.q: How do I submit a paper for approval?

viewAudit.a: Open the Audit log to see who did what and when. Filter by action or search by school or paper name, and export the list as a CSV file.
viewAudit.q: How do I check the audit log?
